integrity: All claims are supported by the displayed structural proof and reproducible finite tests; no unperformed external verification or historical uniqueness certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to synchronous absolute two-contact excitation on finite shared-hub triangles with k>=3 colors. General extinction was already implied, in the 3-color case, by a published induced-density criterion; only sharp time and exact basin-count laws are asserted as additions. Historical equivalence is not fully ruled out. Exhaustive finite simulation is not an infinite proof.
title: Exact extinction-time polynomial for multi-state two-contact excitation on friendship graphs
